title: IRONPROOF: COBOL-to-Python Transpilation with SMT-Based Equivalence Checking
title_zh: IRONPROOF：基于SMT的等价性检查的COBOL到Python转换

paragraphs.en: COBOL remains in production in financial institutions and government agencies, and translating it to a modern language risks changing what the programs compute. Large language models (LLMs) can translate code, but their output carries no guarantee of semantic equivalence, and a divergence on a few inputs can pass conventional testing.
paragraphs.zh: COBOL 仍在金融机构和政府机构的生产环境中使用，将其翻译成现代语言可能会改变程序的计算结果。 大型语言模型（LLM）可以翻译代码，但其输出无法保证语义等价，且在某些输入上的差异可能通过传统测试。

sents.en: COBOL remains in production in financial institutions and government agencies, and translating it to a modern language risks changing what the programs compute.

paragraphs.en: We present Ironproof , an end-to-end pipeline that combines rule-based COBOL-to-Python transpilation with SMT-based formal equivalence verification using the Z3 theorem prover. Given a COBOL program, Ironproof parses the source into an intermediate representation covering common enterprise COBOL constructs, generates Python with Decimal -typed arithmetic and @dataclass working storage, then encodes both programs as Z3 formulas over shared symbolic inputs and checks whether any input witnesses a semantic divergence. If no divergence exists (UNSAT), Ironproof emits a machine-checkable equivalence certificate; if Z3 produces a counterexample (SAT), the tool can return it to an LLM in a correction loop, which this paper describes but does not evaluate.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Ironproof，这是一条端到端的流程，它将基于规则的 COBOL-to-Python 转换与基于 SMT 的形式等价验证相结合，并使用 Z3 定理证明器进行验证。 给定一个 COBOL 程序，Ironproof 会将源代码解析为一种中间表示，涵盖常见的企业级 COBOL 结构；接着生成使用 Decimal 类型算术和 @dataclass 工作存储的 Python 代码，然后将两个程序编码为基于共享符号输入的 Z3 公式，并检查是否存在任何输入能导致语义差异。 如果不存在语义差异（UNSAT），Ironproof 会生成一份机器可验证的等价性证书；如果 Z3 生成反例（SAT），该工具可以将此反例返回给 LLM，用于修正循环。本文描述了这一流程，但并未对其进行评估。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Ironproof on a benchmark of 2,345 COBOL programs drawn from the GnuCOBOL compiler test suite (1,632 programs), the NIST CCVS85 validation suite, open-source enterprise collections, and systematically generated construct variations. The parser accepts all 2,345 programs; our Python generator refuses 400 rather than emit Python it cannot stand behind. A program enters the checking path when its COBOL side yields at least one Z3-encodable output, and 782 do. Of these, 606 (77.5%) are proved equivalent, 101 are only partially verified, none is refuted, and 75 fail inside our own pipeline; the remaining 1,563 yield no encodable output (file I/O, embedded SQL, PERFORM loops, INSPECT) and are reported separately. Our failures stay in the denominator, since a rate that excludes them cannot fall. Two qualifications bound what these proofs mean. The first is provenance: on independently authored programs (GnuCOBOL, NIST, dscobol, community—not written by us) the rate is 52.6% (153 of 291), against 92.3% on programs we wrote. The second is the input domain. 37 of the 153 independent proofs are on programs that read input—a file, ACCEPT , parameters—that the encoder does not model, so each covers a single execution of a program that has many. Only 14 proofs quantify over an input that a proved output depends on, and 15 more have free inputs that no proved output depends on. The remaining 540 are on closed programs, which have one execution and are fully covered by it. On two public business-application corpora (AWS CardDemo and IBM GenApp, 75 programs), the encoder models no program end to end and 1 of 712 paragraphs. A baseline run in April 2026 against LLM-only translation found that the LLM failed on 57% of 94 independently authored programs, counting both Z3-confirmed semantic errors and translations our encoder could not verify. We also report PIC-bounded overflow detection, which flags truncation risks the unbounded encoding does not model. Finally, an earlier confrontation of the proofs with GnuCOBOL 3.2.0, on the pipeline of 2026-08-26, found that 24 of the 49 independently authored proved programs it could execute disagreed with the runtime on a variable inside the proof’s own domain. These figures delimit what an emission-fidelity proof establishes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个基准数据集上对 Ironproof 进行了评估，该数据集包含 2,345 个 COBOL 程序，这些程序来自 GnuCOBOL 编译器测试套件（1,632 个程序）、NIST CCVS85 验证套件、开源企业程序集以及系统生成的结构变体。 解析器能够处理全部 2,345 个程序；而我们的 Python 生成器则拒绝处理了 400 个程序，而不是生成那些它无法为其提供支持的 Python 代码。 当一个程序的 COBOL 部分至少产生一个可编码为 Z3 的输出时，该程序即进入检查流程，共有 782 个程序符合这一条件。 在这些程序中，有 606 个（77.5%）被证明是等价的，101 个仅被部分验证，没有程序被证伪，另有 75 个在我们的内部流程中失败；其余的 1,563 个程序未产生任何可编码的输出（涉及文件 I/O、嵌入式 SQL、PERFORM 循环或 INSPECT），因此被单独报告。 我们的失败案例仍计入分母，因为如果排除这些失败案例，计算出的比率便无法下降。 有两个限定条件界定了这些证明的实际意义。 第一个条件是来源：在由独立作者编写的程序（GnuCOBOL、NIST、dscobol 和社区版本——均非我们编写）中，这一比率为 52.6%（291 个程序中的 153 个），而在我们自己编写的程序中，该比率为 92.3%。 第二个条件是输入域。在 153 个独立证明中，有 37 个涉及读取输入的程序——例如文件、ACCEPT 或参数——而编码器并未对这些输入进行建模，因此每个证明仅覆盖一个程序的单次执行，尽管这些程序可能有多次执行。 仅有 14 个证明对某个已证明输出所依赖的输入进行了量化分析，另有 15 个证明包含自由输入，但这些输入与任何已证明的输出均无关。 其余的 540 个程序属于封闭程序，它们仅有一次执行，且该执行完全覆盖了整个程序的行为。 在两个公开的商业应用语料库（AWS CardDemo 和 IBM GenApp，共 75 个程序）中，编码器未能对任何程序进行端到端的建模，仅能处理 712 个段落中的 1 个。 2026 年 4 月与仅使用 LLM 的翻译方法进行的基准测试发现，在 94 个由独立作者编写的程序中，LLM 在 57% 的程序上出现失败，其中包括 Z3 已确认的语义错误以及我们的编码器无法验证的翻译结果。 我们还报告了 PIC 有界溢出检测功能，该功能能够标记无界编码所未建模的截断风险。 最后，在 2026-08-26 版本流程中，对 GnuCOBOL 3.2.0 的早期对比发现：在其能够执行的 49 个独立编写的已证明程序中，有 24 个程序在证明自身定义域内的某个变量上，与运行时结果不一致。 这些数据界定了“发射保真度”证明所能确立的内容范围。

paragraphs.en: COBOL, designed in 1959, still runs core systems in banking and government; Reuters reported in 2017 that $3 trillion in daily commerce flows through COBOL systems ( Irrera, 2017 ) .
paragraphs.zh: COBOL 于 1959 年问世，至今仍用于运行银行和政府的核心系统；路透社在 2017 年报道称，每日有 3 万亿美元的商业活动通过 COBOL 系统流转（Irrera, 2017）。

paragraphs.en: Modernization translates such code to a language like Java or Python. It requires specialists who understand both ecosystems ( Sneed, 2010 ) , and it can introduce semantic regressions: a misread boundary condition, a rounding difference, or a reordered branch changes results without failing a test that does not exercise it.
paragraphs.zh: 现代化过程会将此类代码转换为 Java 或 Python 等语言。 这需要既了解两种生态系统的专家（Sneed，2010），而且可能引发语义退化：边界条件的误读、舍入差异或分支顺序的重排，都可能在未触发测试的情况下改变结果。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are used for code translation: TransCoder ( Rozière et al., 2020 ) translates between programming languages, and code models such as Codex ( Chen et al., 2021 ) and StarCoder ( Li et al., 2023 ) generate code from natural language. Commercial offerings including IBM watsonx Code Assistant for Z ( IBM, 2026 ) and AWS Mainframe Modernization ( Amazon Web Services, 2026 ) specifically target COBOL migration. LLMs provide no formal guarantee about the semantic correctness of a translation. Pan et al. find that LLM translations between C, C++, Go, Java and Python frequently introduce bugs ( Pan et al., 2024 ) ; such errors can produce correct outputs on most inputs and diverge on specific ones. In financial and governmental code, such an error changes computed amounts for every input it affects.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）被用于代码翻译：TransCoder（Rozière 等人，2020）可在不同编程语言之间进行转换，而 Codex（Chen 等人，2021）和 StarCoder（Li 等人，2023）等代码模型则能根据自然语言生成代码。 商业产品包括 IBM watsonx Code Assistant for Z（IBM，2026）和 AWS Mainframe Modernization（Amazon Web Services，2026），这些产品专门针对 COBOL 的迁移需求。 LLM 并未对翻译结果的语义正确性提供任何正式保证。 Pan 等人发现，LLM 在 C、C++、Go、Java 和 Python 之间的翻译经常引入错误（Pan 等人，2024）；这类错误可能在大多数输入上产生正确输出，但在特定输入上会出现偏差。 在金融和政府代码中，此类错误会改变其影响的每一个输入所计算出的金额。

paragraphs.en: Formal methods offer the complementary guarantee that LLMs lack. Translation validation, as pioneered by Pnueli et al. ( Pnueli et al., 1998 ) and implemented in systems such as CompCert ( Leroy, 2009 ) , Alive2 ( Lopes et al., 2021 ) , and CertiCoq ( Anand et al., 2017 ) , provides machine-checkable proofs that a transformed program preserves the semantics of its source. However, applying formal verification to legacy COBOL migration faces its own challenges: the semantic gap between COBOL and modern languages is large, COBOL’s data model (PIC clauses, group items, REDEFINES) has no direct analog in most target languages, and existing verification infrastructure does not natively support COBOL.

paragraphs.en: Ironproof combines rule-based transpilation with SMT-based equivalence checking and LLM-driven error correction: the rule-based generator produces the translation, the solver either proves it equivalent to our representation of the COBOL or returns a counterexample, and an LLM can be asked to repair a translation the solver refutes.

paragraphs.en: A transpilation pipeline with SMT-based equivalence checking. We present Ironproof , a system that parses COBOL into an intermediate representation, generates Python via rule-based transpilation, encodes both programs as Z3 formulas over shared symbolic inputs, and checks semantic equivalence. The tool also includes a loop that returns Z3 counterexamples to an LLM for correction; it is described but not evaluated here (§ 3 ).

sents.en: A transpilation pipeline with SMT-based equivalence checking.

paragraphs.en: An SMT encoding of the COBOL computational core and its Python translation. We define a parser and Python code generator covering 10 COBOL construct types (arithmetic, conditionals, EVALUATE, PERFORM loops, MOVE, CALL, EXEC SQL, file I/O, GO TO, and COPY books). Of these, four form the Z3-encodable fragment over which we establish formal equivalence—arithmetic operations (COMPUTE, ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY/DIVIDE), MOVE, IF/ELSE, and EVALUATE—together with bounded compositions of them. The remaining six (PERFORM loops, CALL, EXEC SQL, file I/O, GO TO, and COPY books) are detected and not encoded; an output that depends on them is left unverified rather than proved (§ 3.3 ). Some proved programs still contain such constructs, flattened identically on both sides by the shared parser; § 5.4 counts them (31 of 606).
paragraphs.zh: COBOL计算核心的SMT编码及其Python翻译版本。 我们定义了一个解析器和Python代码生成器，涵盖10种COBOL结构类型（算术运算、条件判断、EVALUATE、PERFORM循环、MOVE、CALL、EXEC SQL、文件I/O、GO TO和COPY书籍）。 其中，有四种结构构成了可在Z3上编码的片段，我们在此片段上建立了形式等价性——包括算术运算（COMPUTE、ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY/DIVIDE）、MOVE、IF/ELSE和EVALUATE，以及它们的有界组合。 其余六种结构（PERFORM循环、CALL、EXEC SQL、文件I/O、GO TO和COPY书籍）被检测出来但未进行编码；依赖这些结构的输出结果保持未验证状态，而非被证明正确（§ 3.3）。 部分已证明正确的程序仍包含此类结构，但通过共享解析器在两侧进行了相同的扁平化处理；§ 5.4对它们进行了统计（606个程序中有31个）。

paragraphs.en: A large-scale empirical evaluation with LLM baseline. We evaluate Ironproof on 2,345 COBOL programs, including 1,632 from the GnuCOBOL compiler test suite and 69 from the NIST CCVS85 validation suite. We prove equivalence on 606 of the 782 programs that enter the checking path (77.5%; 52.6% on independently authored code), state how many of those proofs cover a single execution of a program that reads input (37) and how many quantify over an input that a proved output depends on (14), and compare against an LLM-only baseline run in April 2026, which fails on 54 of 94 independently authored programs (57%), counting translations our encoder could not verify as failures. We also introduce PIC-bounded overflow detection (§ 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一项基于 LLM 基线模型的大规模实证评估。 我们在 2,345 个 COBOL 程序上对 Ironproof 进行了评估，其中包括来自 GnuCOBOL 编译器测试集的 1,632 个程序和来自 NIST CCVS85 验证集的 69 个程序。 对于进入检查路径的 782 个程序中的 606 个（占 77.5%；其中独立编写的代码为 52.6%），我们证明了其等价性；同时说明了这些证明中有多少覆盖了程序读取输入的单次执行（37 个），以及有多少针对输入进行了量化分析，即已证明输出依赖于该输入（14 个）；此外，我们还与 2026 年 4 月仅使用 LLM 运行的基线模型进行了比较，该模型在 94 个独立编写的程序中失败了 54 个（占 57%），其中我们的编码器无法验证的翻译也被计为失败。 我们还引入了 PIC 有界溢出检测机制（§ 5）。

paragraphs.en: Ironproof ’s parser operates in three phases: preprocessing, lexical normalization, and structural parsing.

paragraphs.en: A preprocessor resolves COPY book directives by searching a configurable set of directories for the referenced copybook files ( .cpy , .cbl , .cob ), inlining their contents at the point of reference. This is necessary because COBOL programs in production frequently factor shared data definitions into copybooks that are included at compile time.
paragraphs.zh: 预处理器通过在一个可配置的目录集合中搜索所引用的抄本文件（.cpy、.cbl、.cob），将它们的内嵌内容置于引用位置，从而解析 COPY 抄本指令。 这是因为生产环境中的 COBOL 程序通常会将共享的数据定义提取到抄本中，并在编译时将其包含进来。

paragraphs.en: COBOL’s fixed-format layout (columns 1–6 for sequence numbers, column 7 for continuation/comment indicators, columns 8–72 for code) is normalized: comment lines (column 7 = * or / ) are removed, and the code area is extracted and uppercased. This produces a flat token stream amenable to recursive-descent parsing.
paragraphs.zh: COBOL 的固定格式布局（第 1–6 列为序列号，第 7 列为续行/注释标识符，第 8–72 列为代码）被标准化处理：注释行（第 7 列为 * 或 /）被移除，代码区域则被提取并转为大写。 这样便生成了一条平坦的标记流，适合采用递归下降解析法进行解析。

paragraphs.en: The parser identifies two top-level divisions: the Data Division , from which it extracts variable declarations with PIC clauses, and the Procedure Division , which it decomposes into named paragraphs and a main body. The PicType system models COBOL’s picture-string type notation, extracting integer digit count, decimal digit count, signedness, and alphanumeric status from PIC strings such as S9(8)V99 or X(20) .
paragraphs.zh: 解析器识别出两个顶级部分：数据部分（Data Division），从中提取带有 PIC 子句的变量声明；以及过程部分（Procedure Division），将其分解为带名称的段落和主体。 PicType 系统对 COBOL 的图片字符串类型表示法进行建模，从诸如 S9(8)V99 或 X(20) 之类的 PIC 字符串中提取整数位数、小数位数、符号性以及字母数字状态等信息。

paragraphs.en: The parser recognizes 10 COBOL construct types, each mapped to a typed intermediate representation (IR) node:
paragraphs.zh: 解析器可识别 10 种 COBOL 结构类型，每种类型都映射到一个带类型的中间表示（IR）节点：

paragraphs.en: COMPUTE : Arithmetic assignment ( COMPUTE X = expr ).
paragraphs.zh: 计算：算术赋值（计算 X = expr）。

paragraphs.en: IF/ELSE : Conditional branching with compound conditions (AND/OR), nested bodies, and optional ELSE.
paragraphs.zh: IF/ELSE：带有复合条件（AND/OR）、嵌套主体和可选 ELSE 的有条件分支。

paragraphs.en: EVALUATE : Multi-way branching (COBOL’s switch/case), including EVALUATE TRUE with arbitrary conditions per WHEN clause.
paragraphs.zh: EVALUATE：多向分支（COBOL 的 switch/case），包括在每个 WHEN 子句中均可使用任意条件的 EVALUATE TRUE。

paragraphs.en: PERFORM : Loop constructs, including PERFORM n TIMES , PERFORM UNTIL , PERFORM VARYING , and paragraph invocation.
paragraphs.zh: 执行：循环结构，包括“执行 n 次”、“执行直到”、“执行变体”以及段落调用。

paragraphs.en: MOVE : Data movement ( MOVE src TO tgt1 tgt2 ).
paragraphs.zh: MOVE：数据移动（MOVE src TO tgt1 tgt2）。

paragraphs.en: ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY/DIVIDE : Arithmetic verbs with optional GIVING and REMAINDER clauses.
paragraphs.zh: 加法/减法/乘法/除法：算术动词，可选配“给予”和“余数”子句。

paragraphs.en: CALL : Subprogram invocation ( CALL ’prog’ USING var1 var2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 调用：子程序调用（ CALL ’prog’ USING var1 var2 ）。

paragraphs.en: EXEC SQL : Embedded SQL with INTO host variable binding.
paragraphs.zh: 执行 SQL：带 INTO 主机变量绑定的嵌入式 SQL。

paragraphs.en: File I/O : OPEN , READ (with AT END ), WRITE (with FROM ), and CLOSE .
paragraphs.zh: 文件 I/O：打开、读取（带 AT END）、写入（带 FROM）和关闭。

paragraphs.en: GO TO : Unconditional transfer of control, flagged for manual review.
paragraphs.zh: 转到：无条件控制转移，已标记为需人工审核。

paragraphs.en: The parser produces a IronproofProgram structure containing the program name, a dictionary of typed variables, a dictionary of named paragraphs (each containing a list of IR statements), the main procedure body, resolved copybook references, and Boolean flags indicating the presence of SQL, file I/O, and GO TO constructs.
paragraphs.zh: 解析器会生成一个 IronproofProgram 结构，其中包含程序名称、一个类型化变量字典、一个命名段落字典（每个段落都包含一个 IR 语句列表）、主过程体、已解析的抄本引用，以及用于指示是否存在 SQL、文件 I/O 和 GO TO 结构的布尔标志。

paragraphs.en: The code generator maps the COBOL IR to Python. Three design decisions merit discussion.
paragraphs.zh: 代码生成器将 COBOL IR 映射为 Python。 有三个设计决策值得讨论。

sents.en: The code generator maps the COBOL IR to Python.
sents.zh: 代码生成器将 COBOL IR 映射为 Python。

sents.en: Three design decisions merit discussion.
sents.zh: 有三个设计决策值得讨论。

paragraphs.en: COBOL’s fixed-point decimal arithmetic is semantically distinct from IEEE 754 floating-point. A COBOL variable declared as PIC 9(8)V99 represents a decimal number with 8 integer digits and 2 fractional digits, with exact decimal semantics. We map all numeric COBOL variables to Python’s decimal.Decimal type, preserving exact arithmetic. This avoids an entire class of translation bugs related to floating-point rounding.
paragraphs.zh: COBOL 的定点小数运算在语义上与 IEEE 754 浮点运算存在显著差异。 声明为 PIC 9(8)V99 的 COBOL 变量表示一个包含 8 位整数和 2 位小数的十进制数，具有精确的十进制语义。 我们将所有数值型 COBOL 变量映射到 Python 的 decimal.Decimal 类型，以保留精确的算术运算。 这避免了与浮点舍入相关的一类翻译错误。

paragraphs.en: COBOL’s WORKING-STORAGE SECTION defines program-scoped mutable state. We represent this as a Python @dataclass named WorkingStorage , with each COBOL variable mapped to a typed field with an appropriate default value derived from its PIC clause. This provides a single, typed state container that is passed to all generated functions, mirroring COBOL’s flat variable namespace.
paragraphs.zh: COBOL 的 WORKING-STORAGE SECTION 定义了程序作用域内的可变状态。 我们将其表示为一个名为 WorkingStorage 的 Python @dataclass，其中每个 COBOL 变量都映射到一个带有适当默认值（该值源自其 PIC 子句）的类型化字段。 这提供了一个单一的类型化状态容器，该容器会被传递给所有生成的函数，从而模拟了 COBOL 的扁平变量命名空间。

GO TO statements are translated to function calls with a review comment, as COBOL’s unstructured control flow cannot always be faithfully represented in Python’s structured control model.

paragraphs.en: The core of Ironproof ’s verification is a dual encoding: both the COBOL program (via its IR) and the Python translation (via its AST) are mapped to Z3 formulas over shared symbolic variables.
paragraphs.zh: Ironproof 验证的核心是一种双重编码：COBOL 程序（通过其 IR）和 Python 翻译版本（通过其 AST）都被映射到共享符号变量上的 Z3 公式。

paragraphs.en: For each numeric variable in the COBOL program’s WORKING-STORAGE , we create a Z3 Real variable. Variables that are read before they are written and are not fixed by a VALUE clause become input variables ; variables that are assigned become output variables . The equivalence question is then: for all valuations of input variables, do the COBOL and Python programs produce identical output variables?
paragraphs.zh: 对于 COBOL 程序中 WORKING-STORAGE 里的每个数值变量，我们都创建一个 Z3 Real 变量。 在写入之前被读取且未通过 VALUE 子句固定的变量成为输入变量；而被赋值的变量则成为输出变量。 等价性问题因此变为：对于输入变量的所有赋值情况，COBOL 程序和 Python 程序是否会产生完全相同的输出变量？

paragraphs.en: COMPUTE and arithmetic verbs update the symbolic environment by evaluating the expression tree over Z3 terms.
paragraphs.zh: COMPUTE 和算术动词通过评估基于 Z3 项的表达式树来更新符号环境。

paragraphs.en: IF and EVALUATE produce Z3 If(cond, then_val, else_val) terms, merging the symbolic state from each branch.
paragraphs.zh: IF 和 EVALUATE 会生成 Z3 If(cond, then_val, else_val) 项，并合并每个分支中的符号状态。

paragraphs.en: MOVE propagates the source value (or a Z3 constant for literals) to the target variables.
paragraphs.zh: MOVE 将源值（或字面量的 Z3 常量）传播到目标变量。

paragraphs.en: Conditions are mapped to Z3 comparisons: <= , < , >= , > , = , and NOT= .
paragraphs.zh: 条件被映射到 Z3 比较操作符：<=、<、>=、>、= 和 NOT=。

paragraphs.en: The Python source is parsed using Python’s ast module. The AST is then traversed with a symbolic interpreter that maps assignments to Z3 updates, conditionals to Z3 If terms, arithmetic to Z3 arithmetic, and Decimal constructors to Z3 RealVal constants. The traversal produces a set of output variable formulas analogous to those from the COBOL encoding.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Python 的 ast 模块对 Python 源代码进行解析。 接着，通过一个符号解释器遍历该抽象语法树（AST），该解释器将赋值操作映射为 Z3 更新，条件语句映射为 Z3 If 项，算术运算映射为 Z3 算术表达式，而 Decimal 构造函数则映射为 Z3 RealVal 常量。 该遍历过程生成一组输出变量公式，与 COBOL 编码中生成的公式类似。

paragraphs.en: This encoding covers pure computational sections : straight-line arithmetic, conditionals, and multi-way branches without loops, I/O, or external calls. The use of Z3 Real (infinite-precision rationals) means the encoding is an over-approximation: it does not model overflow, truncation on store, or rounding (see § 6 ). For PERFORM loops we do not encode the loop body symbolically (which would require loop invariant synthesis); an output that depends on a loop is left unverified, unless the parser has flattened the loop identically on both sides (§ 5.4 ). Similarly, EXEC SQL, file I/O, CALL, and GO TO constructs are flagged but not encoded. The certificate records which constructs were detected and which were formally verified.
paragraphs.zh: 这种编码涵盖了纯粹的计算部分：直线算术运算、条件判断以及无循环、I/O 或外部调用的多路分支。 使用 Z3 Real（无限精度有理数）意味着这种编码是一种过度近似：它没有模拟溢出、存储时的截断或四舍五入（参见 § 6）。 对于 PERFORM 循环，我们不会以符号方式编码循环体（这需要进行循环不变量合成）；依赖于循环的输出将保持未验证状态，除非解析器在两侧对循环进行了完全相同的扁平化处理（§ 5.4）。 同样地，EXEC SQL、文件 I/O、CALL 和 GO TO 结构会被标记，但不会被编码。 证书记录了哪些结构被检测到，以及哪些经过了形式化验证。

paragraphs.en: The correction prompt includes: (1) the original COBOL source, (2) the current (incorrect) Python translation, (3) the concrete counterexample input values, (4) the expected output (from the COBOL Z3 formula) and the actual output (from the Python Z3 formula), and (5) an instruction to fix the specific semantic divergence. This provides the LLM with a precise, actionable error signal rather than a vague instruction to “try again.”

paragraphs.en: LLM Backend : The LLM backend for COBOL-to-Python translation and correction. We use claude-opus-4-7 with a 2,048-token output limit; all LLM results reported here were produced with that model, and the raw result files record it. The translation prompt instructs the model to produce a single function, use Decimal types, preserve exact conditions, and emit no comments or imports. We report results with a single model; comparative evaluation across LLMs is left to future work.

paragraphs.en: Upon successful equivalence verification, Ironproof emits a JSON certificate containing: the program name, a verdict ( EQUIVALENT , NON-EQUIVALENT , TRADUCTION-INVALIDE for a translation that does not run, or ABSTENTION when nothing is refuted but not every output is proved), SHA-256 hashes of both source and target, the proof method, a formal proof statement ( ¬ ∃ ⁡ x → : f C ​ ( x → ) ≠ f P ​ ( x → ) \neg\exists\vec{x}:f_{C}(\vec{x})\neq f_{P}(\vec{x}) for equivalence), a list of detected constructs (SQL, file I/O, GO TO, paragraph count, resolved copybooks), and per-variable proof results including status, timing, counterexample (if any), and details. To make “machine-checkable” literal rather than nominal, each proved variable also carries the self-contained SMT-LIB2 obligation Z3 discharged (declarations, assertions, and check-sat ); a third party re-checks a certificate by feeding each obligation to any SMT solver and confirming unsat , without trusting our solver invocation. We verify this end-to-end in papers/verify_smt2.py , which re-checks every obligation in a fresh z3 instance (113 of 113 obligations unsat on the first 40 proved programs).
paragraphs.zh: 在成功完成等价性验证后，Ironproof 会生成一个 JSON 证书，其中包含：程序名称、判定结果（等价的 EQUIVALENT、不等价的 NON-EQUIVALENT、翻译无法运行的情况下的 TRANSLATION-INVALIDE，或当未证伪任何内容但无法证明所有输出时使用的 ABSTENTION）、源程序和目标程序的 SHA-256 哈希值、证明方法、形式化证明陈述（等价性为 ¬∃ x: f_C( x ) ≠ f_P( x )），已检测到的构造列表（SQL、文件 I/O、GO TO、段落数量、已解析的抄本），以及每个变量的证明结果，包括状态、耗时、反例（如有）和详细信息。 为了让“机器可验证”不仅停留在名义上而是真正具备可操作性，每个经过证明的变量还附带了由 Z3 解除的自包含 SMT-LIB2 约束（声明、断言和 check-sat）；第三方可通过将每个约束输入任意 SMT 求解器并确认其 unsat 状态来重新验证证书，而无需信任我们调用求解器的过程。 我们在 papers/verify_smt2.py 中对此进行了端到端的验证，该脚本会在一个新的 z3 实例中重新检查所有约束（在前 40 个已证明的程序中，113 个约束中的全部 113 个均为 unsat）。

paragraphs.en: The COBOL parser handles a subset of the COBOL-85 standard. It does not handle: INSPECT / STRING / UNSTRING (string manipulation), SORT / MERGE (file sorting), ALTER (self-modifying code), REDEFINES (storage overlay), OCCURS / OCCURS DEPENDING ON (table handling), COMP-3 (packed decimal), level-88 condition names (Boolean flags), or nested programs. These are recognized and flagged rather than silently ignored. We note that several of these unsupported constructs (level-88, OCCURS , REDEFINES ) are pervasive in production COBOL and represent a significant gap in coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 该 COBOL 解析器支持 COBOL-85 标准的一个子集。 它不支持以下功能：INSPECT / STRING / UNSTRING（字符串操作）、SORT / MERGE（文件排序）、ALTER（自修改代码）、REDEFINES（存储覆盖）、OCCURS / OCCURS DEPENDING ON（表处理）、COMP-3（打包十进制）、level-88 条件名（布尔标志）或嵌套程序。 这些功能会被识别并标记出来，而不是被静默忽略。 我们注意到，这些未受支持的构造中的一些（level-88、OCCURS、REDEFINES）在生产环境中的 COBOL 代码中广泛存在，这代表了其覆盖范围的一个重大缺失。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Ironproof along five research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们从五个研究问题出发，对 Ironproof 进行评估：

paragraphs.en: On what fraction of COBOL programs do parsing and Python emission run to completion without crashing?

paragraphs.en: How many translations does Z3 prove semantically equivalent?
paragraphs.zh: Z3 证明了有多少个翻译在语义上是等价的？

paragraphs.en: What is the runtime performance of the pipeline?
paragraphs.zh: 该流程的运行时性能如何？

paragraphs.en: Can PIC-bounded overflow detection identify errors missed by unbounded verification?
paragraphs.zh: PIC 受限的溢出检测能否识别无限制验证所遗漏的错误？

paragraphs.en: We assembled a benchmark suite of 2,345 COBOL files from multiple open-source repositories (Table 2 ). They include 76 byte-identical copies, in 59 groups, mostly among the GnuCOBOL tests; we count files, as every figure of this paper does. The suite comprises: (1) 1,632 programs extracted from the GnuCOBOL compiler test suite, which exercises the full breadth of COBOL-85 constructs; (2) 69 programs from the NIST CCVS85 standard validation suite ( National Institute of Standards and Technology, 1986 ) (public domain); (3) 113 programs from the dscobol enterprise COBOL collection (DB2, VSAM, batch); (4) 31 community programs: 23 from COBOL-Examples (MIT) and 8 from the Open Mainframe Project COBOL Programming Course (OMP, CC-BY-4.0); (5) 60 hand-written programs covering all 10 supported construct types plus 5 stress tests targeting DIVIDE INTO semantics, PIC overflow, and decimal truncation; and (6) 440 systematically generated programs covering combinatorial variations of arithmetic, conditionals, and control flow.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从多个开源仓库中收集了一套包含 2,345 个 COBOL 文件的基准测试集（表 2）。 这些文件包括 76 个字节完全相同的副本，分布在 59 个组中，主要见于 GnuCOBOL 的测试用例；本文所有图表均按文件数量进行统计。 该测试集包含以下内容：(1) 从 GnuCOBOL 编译器测试套件中提取的 1,632 个程序，该套件全面检验了 COBOL-85 的所有语法结构；(2) 来自 NIST CCVS85 标准验证套件（美国国家标准与技术研究院，1986 年）的 69 个程序（公共领域）；(3) 来自 dscobol 企业级 COBOL 集合的 113 个程序（DB2、VSAM、批处理）；(4) 31 个社区贡献的程序：其中 23 个来自 COBOL-Examples（MIT），8 个来自 Open Mainframe Project COBOL 编程课程（OMP，CC-BY-4.0）；(5) 60 个手工编写的程序，涵盖了全部 10 种支持的语法类型，并包含 5 个针对 DIVIDE INTO 语义、PIC 溢出和十进制截断的应力测试；以及 (6) 440 个通过系统方法生成的程序，覆盖了算术运算、条件判断和控制流的组合变化。

paragraphs.en: Counting non-empty lines, programs range from 4 to 7,693 lines (median: 18, mean: 68). The proved fragment (606 programs) ranges from 8 to 7,693 lines (median: 17, mean: 130); a few very large GnuCOBOL test programs pull the mean up. The GnuCOBOL, NIST, dscobol, and community programs are independently authored COBOL: not written by the author of this paper. They are not free of selection, since the exclusions in the footnote to Table 2 remove programs outside our parser’s or encoder’s reach; only the generated and hand-written sets are ours. We use this definition of “independently authored” throughout. paragraphs.en: An earlier version of the pipeline was not deterministic: three runs on an unchanged tree and corpus produced 586, 587, and 588 proved programs and either six or seven refutations. The cause was three set-union iterations ( set(then_env) | set(else_env) ) in the Z3 encoder—Python randomizes set iteration order per process, which changed the order in which the merged If -expressions were assembled and thus the order assertions reached the solver, flipping a small number of marginal queries between unsat , sat , and unknown . (An earlier note attributing this to dict iteration was wrong: Python 3.7+ dicts are insertion-ordered and unaffected.) Sorting those unions by variable name removed the dependency at its source. The figures of this version were produced with PYTHONHASHSEED=0 ; the two scripts that check them against this paper ( check_paper_numbers.py , check_paper_consistency.py ) refuse to run without it. A second defect of the same encoder made the figures unreproducible in a different way: the merge rebuilt If(c, x, x) for every assigned variable, even when no branch had touched it, and on one 7,693-line GnuCOBOL program the term grew until a run no longer finished. paragraphs.en: A self-authored benchmark can be written to favour the tool, so we separate the proof rate by who wrote the code, over the full checking-path denominator , including our own failures. Of the 291 independently authored programs that enter the checking path (GnuCOBOL, NIST CCVS85, dscobol, and community sources—not written by us), 153 prove equivalent (52.6%) ; none is refuted, 66 are partially verified, and 72 fail inside our pipeline. 72 of the 75 pipeline failures fall on this independent code , where real-world constructs exceed what the current encoding and generator handle. On the 491 programs we generated or wrote, 453 prove (92.3%), 35 are partially verified and 3 fail. That rate reflects programs that stay inside the encoder’s designed scope, and all 453 of those proofs are over closed programs; this is why we do not headline it. On the independent side, 37 of the 153 proofs cover a single execution of an open program (§ 5.3 ); counting only proofs that are complete for their program, the independent rate is 116 of 291 (39.9%). The figure for code we did not write is therefore 52.6%, reported without excluding our failures from its denominator; the 77.5% of § 5.3 is a blend of the two populations and should be read as such. The split is re-derivable with papers/provenance_breakdown.py . § 5.5 reports what a reference COBOL implementation said about an earlier version of this figure.

paragraphs.en: A natural objection to any self-verifying transpiler is circularity: if both sides of the equivalence query are derived from the same intermediate representation, the solver is being asked whether a system agrees with itself, and UNSAT is guaranteed regardless of correctness. We state precisely where the two sides come from, and then give the empirical evidence that they are not the same side.
paragraphs.zh: 对任何自我验证的编译器而言，一个自然的质疑是循环性：如果等价查询的两边都源自同一个中间表示，那么求解器实际上是在询问一个系统是否与自己一致，而无论其正确性如何，结果都必然是 UNSAT。 我们明确说明这两边分别来自何处，然后提供经验证据表明它们并非同一侧。

The Python side is not : it is obtained by re-parsing the emitted Python source text with the standard ast module and encoding the resulting syntax tree independently (§ 3.3 ). The two encoders therefore share the parser but not the code generator, and a query can distinguish them exactly when the generator’s output diverges from the IR it was generated from.

And on 2026-08-26 our own generator was refuted on six programs (Table 4 ): in gnucobol_320 , Z3 returned a counterexample on CNTR-RCD-WRITTEN in which the COBOL side evaluated to 0 0 and the emitted Python to 0 + 1 0+1 . Those six are not refuted today, but not because the defects were repaired. The later hardening stops them earlier: three are refused by the generator, two no longer yield an encodable output, and one is partially verified. We report this rather than present the zero as a cleaner generator.

paragraphs.en: Because both sides inherit the same parser, the obligation establishes fidelity of emission (IR → \to Python), not fidelity of parsing (COBOL → \to IR). A construct the parser misreads is misread identically on both sides, and the query returns UNSAT on a translation that is wrong with respect to the COBOL standard. A proof emitted by Ironproof should therefore be read as: the generated Python computes what our IR says the COBOL computes . Establishing that the IR itself says the right thing requires an independent oracle; § 5.5 reports what such an oracle says when we build one.
paragraphs.zh: 由于双方都继承相同的解析器，该义务确保了生成的保真度（IR → \to Python），而非解析的保真度（COBOL → \to IR）。 解析器误读的构造在两侧都会被以相同方式误读，并且对于不符合 COBOL 标准的翻译，查询将返回 UNSAT。 因此，由 Ironproof 生成的证明应被解读为：所生成的 Python 代码计算出的结果与我们的 IR 所描述的 COBOL 计算结果一致。 要确认 IR 本身表述正确，需要一个独立的预言机；§ 5.5 报告了我们在构建这样一个预言机时它给出的结果。

sents.en: Because both sides inherit the same parser, the obligation establishes fidelity of emission (IR → \to Python), not fidelity of parsing (COBOL → \to IR).

paragraphs.en: A second gap is narrower and we state it explicitly because it is easy to miss: the Python side of the obligation is a model of the emitted file, not the file as CPython runs it. _build_python_z3 enumerates every function definition in the emitted module and encodes each body in source order against a shared environment; it never consults the module’s __main__ block. When the emitted __main__ calls a different entry point than that enumeration effectively assumes, the theorem and the artifact describe different computations. We quantify this in § 5.5 . Relatedly, the Python environment is seeded with the COBOL VALUE constants ( _build_python_z3(python_src, all_cobol_vars) ), so both sides share the initial state by construction and no initialization discrepancy between the two artifacts is expressible as a counterexample.

paragraphs.en: For each program we auto-generate a DISPLAY of every variable in the proof’s domain, insert it before each reachable terminator and at end of unit, compile the instrumented source with GnuCOBOL 3.2.0 ( cobc -x ), execute the emitted Python, and compare the two final states as exact decimals. paragraphs.en: Of the 113 independently authored programs holding an EQUIVALENT verdict in that snapshot, 60 compile as written under cobc -x , 71 compile once modules and alternative source formats are accepted, and 49 are confrontable end to end . The 64 that are not are dominated by compiler bug-report fragments that do not compile standalone, subprograms requiring a driver, and programs whose input surface has no fixture. This is a selection effect that works against the reported figure: the 49 are the simplest programs in the set—self-contained, single compilation unit, no external input.
paragraphs.zh: 在那個快照中，有 113 個由不同作者獨立撰寫且評定為「等價」的程式：其中 60 個在 cobc -x 下可直接編譯；71 個在接受模組和替代資料來源格式後可以編譯；49 個則能從頭到尾完整運行。 其餘無法完整運行的 64 個程式，主要包含無法獨立編譯的編譯器錯誤報告片段、需要驅動程式的子程式，以及輸入介面缺乏固定格式的程式。 這是一種選擇偏誤，會使報告的數值產生偏差：這 49 個程式是該集合中最簡單的程式——自給自足、單一編譯單元，且無外部輸入。

paragraphs.en: On those 49, 24 disagree with the reference runtime on at least one variable in the proof’s own domain. Each disagreement survives an invariance check against any rescaling of our PICTURE interpretation, so none is an artifact of how we read the probe output. The dominant mechanism is store-time truncation: the encoder models numeric data as unbounded reals, whereas COBOL truncates on assignment to the receiving field’s PICTURE , applies ROUNDED only where declared, and leaves a field unchanged on an unhandled size error. This is the same phenomenon our PIC-bounded analysis (§ 5.7 ) flags statically, observed here as a divergence rather than a warning.
paragraphs.zh: 在这 49 个案例中，有 24 个与参考运行时间在证明自身域内的至少一个变量上存在分歧。 每种分歧都通过了针对我们对 PICTURE 解释的任何重新缩放的不变性检查，因此没有分歧是我们解读探针输出方式造成的伪影。 主要机制是存储时的截断：编码器将数值数据建模为无界实数，而 COBOL 在赋值给接收字段的 PICTURE 时进行截断，仅在声明处应用 ROUNDED，并在未处理的大小错误时保持字段不变。 这正是我们的 PIC-有界分析（§ 5.7）在静态检查中标出的同一现象，此处表现为分歧而非警告。

paragraphs.en: Ironproof ’s overflow detection mode checks whether any output variable can exceed its PIC-declared range under valid inputs. This goes beyond equivalence checking: even if COBOL and Python produce identical results, an overflow in the COBOL program indicates a latent bug that the migration should surface rather than silently reproduce.
paragraphs.zh: Ironproof 的溢出检测模式会检查在有效输入条件下，任何输出变量是否可能超出其在 PIC 中声明的范围。 这超越了等价性检查：即使 COBOL 和 Python 程序产生完全相同的结果，COBOL 程序中的溢出也表明存在一个潜在错误，迁移过程应当暴露这一错误，而不是静默地复制它。

paragraphs.en: We ran the detector over every program entering the checking path. Of the 782, 754 complete the overflow analysis; for 27 the COBOL encoding raises before the query, and for 1 the overflow query itself fails. The detector uses only the COBOL side, so the 47 programs our generator refuses are analyzed. 167 of the 754 (22.1%) contain at least one output variable that Z3 can drive outside its PIC-declared range , for 4,845 flagged variables in total. The distribution is concentrated: 99 programs flag a single variable, 31 flag two, and 37 flag three or more; the maximum, 500 variables, comes from one very large GnuCOBOL test program. The figures are re-derivable with papers/overflow_breakdown.py .
paragraphs.zh: 我们对进入检查路径的每个程序都运行了检测器。 在 782 个程序中，有 754 个完成了溢出分析；对于其中的 27 个，COBOL 编码在查询之前就已触发警报，而 1 个程序的溢出查询本身则失败。 该检测器仅使用 COBOL 部分，因此我们生成器拒绝处理的 47 个程序也进行了分析。在 754 个程序中，有 167 个（22.1%）至少包含一个输出变量，Z3 可以将其驱动到其 PIC 声明范围之外，总共涉及 4,845 个被标记的变量。 分布情况较为集中：99 个程序标记了单个变量，31 个标记了两个变量，37 个标记了三个或更多变量；其中最多的一个程序标记了 500 个变量，这来自一个非常大的 GnuCOBOL 测试程序。 这些数字可以通过 papers/overflow_breakdown.py 重新计算得出。

paragraphs.en: This is an upper bound on real risk, not a defect count. The analysis quantifies over unconstrained symbolic inputs, so any accumulator narrow enough will admit some valuation that overflows it—a PIC 9(2) record counter is flagged even if the file it counts never holds a hundred records. Establishing which flags correspond to reachable states requires input constraints the source does not carry, which we do not infer. The useful reading is a ranking of where narrow fields meet unbounded arithmetic, not a verdict on each site. What the measurement does establish is that the condition is common rather than exotic: it is not confined to a stress test we wrote.
paragraphs.zh: 这是实际风险的一个上界，而非缺陷数量。 该分析针对无约束的符号输入进行了量化，因此任何足够狭窄的累加器都会存在某些导致溢出的赋值——即使所计数的文件从未包含过一百条记录，一个 PIC 9(2) 的记录计数器仍会被标记。 确定哪些标志对应可达状态需要源数据中未包含的输入约束，而这些约束我们并未进行推断。 有用的解读是，这反映的是狭窄字段与无界算术相遇时的排序情况，而非对每个位置的最终判定。 该测量确实证实的是，这种情况属于常见现象而非特例：它并不仅限于我们所编写的压力测试。

paragraphs.en: On our overflow stress test (program OVERFLOW-TEST , 13 variables), the detector identifies three PIC range violations, each with a concrete witness:
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的溢出压力测试（程序 OVERFLOW-TEST，13 个变量）中，检测器识别出三个 PIC 范围违规，每个违规都有一个具体的见证：

paragraphs.en: WS-OVERFLOW-SUM ( PIC 9(2) , range [0, 99]): computed value 105 exceeds capacity. In COBOL, the high-order digit is truncated, producing 05. In Python, the value is 105.
paragraphs.zh: WS-OVERFLOW-SUM ( PIC 9(2) , range [0, 99]): 计算值 105 超过了容量。 在 COBOL 中，高位数字会被截断，结果为 05。 在 Python 中，该值为 105。

sents.en: In COBOL, the high-order digit is truncated, producing 05.
sents.zh: 在 COBOL 中，高位数字会被截断，结果为 05。

sents.zh: 在 Python 中，该值为 105。

paragraphs.zh: WS-TOTAL-PCT（PIC 9(2)V99，范围 [0, 99.99]）：三个百分比之和为 100.00，超过了该字段的容量。

paragraphs.zh: WS-NEW-BAL（PIC 9(3)V99，范围 [0, 999.99]）：存款使余额增至 1005.50，超过了 3 位数的容量。

paragraphs.en: For programs with symbolic inputs, the Z3 solver searches for input valuations that produce out-of-range outputs, providing concrete counterexamples when overflow is possible.
paragraphs.zh: 对于具有符号输入的程序，Z3 求解器会搜索能够产生超出范围输出的输入赋值，并在可能发生溢出时提供具体的反例。

paragraphs.en: The check targets computations where COBOL’s truncation on store diverges from Python’s arbitrary-precision arithmetic, which the unbounded equivalence query does not model.
paragraphs.zh: 该检查针对的是 COBOL 在存储时的截断操作与 Python 的任意精度算术存在差异的计算，而无界等价查询并未对此进行建模。

paragraphs.en: To quantify the value of Ironproof ’s rule-based transpilation and Z3 verification layer, we compare against a baseline consisting of direct LLM translation without any formal verification. For each of the 586 programs in the proved fragment as identified when this experiment was run, in April 2026, we prompt the same LLM used in the feedback loop (§ 3.4 ) to translate the COBOL source to Python, then verify the LLM-generated translation against the COBOL IR using Z3. This set is not the current proved fragment (606 programs, § 5.3 ), and the baseline has not been re-run on the current code, which would require new LLM calls; we report the set and the encoder actually used rather than restate them against a run the baseline did not use.
paragraphs.zh: 为了量化 Ironproof 的规则驱动式转换层和 Z3 验证层的价值，我们将其与一个基准方案进行比较：该基准方案仅使用直接 LLM 翻译，不涉及任何形式化验证。 在 2026 年 4 月，针对本次实验所识别出的证明片段中的 586 个程序中的每一个，我们都提示了反馈循环（§ 3.4）中使用的同一 LLM，将 COBOL 源代码翻译成 Python，然后使用 Z3 验证 LLM 生成的翻译结果是否与 COBOL IR 一致。 这组程序并非当前的证明片段（606 个程序，§ 5.3），且基准方案尚未在当前的代码上重新运行——这需要进行新的 LLM 调用；因此，我们报告实际使用的程序和编码器，而不是针对基准方案未运行的测试重新陈述它们。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 summarizes the results. Ironproof ’s column is 586 of 586 by construction (the set was defined as the programs it proved). The LLM-only baseline produces 38 confirmed semantic errors (Z3 returns SAT with a concrete counterexample) and 28 translations that fall outside our verification scope—either because the LLM emitted Python constructs our Z3 encoder cannot model, or because the equivalence query timed out as UNKNOWN. On this set Ironproof has neither category, because the set was defined as the programs it proved. We report the 38 SAT-confirmed errors and the 28 unverifiable translations together (66 programs total, 11.3%) as the gap that formal verification detects; only the 38 SAT cases are categorized in the error taxonomy below, since UNKNOWN outcomes do not yield a diagnostic counterexample.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 总结了这些结果。 根据构造方式，Ironproof 的列是 586/586（该集合被定义为它所能证明的程序）。 仅使用 LLM 的基线模型产生了 38 个经确认的语义错误（Z3 返回 SAT 并附带具体的反例），以及 28 个超出我们验证范围的翻译——这些翻译要么是因为 LLM 生成了我们的 Z3 编码器无法建模的 Python 结构，要么是因为等价性查询超时返回了 UNKNOWN。 在这个集合上，Ironproof 不属于上述任何一类，因为该集合被定义为它所能证明的程序。 我们将这 38 个经 SAT 确认的错误和 28 个无法验证的翻译合并报告（总计 66 个程序，占 11.3%），作为形式化验证检测到的差距；在下面的错误分类中，只有 38 个 SAT 案例被归类，因为 UNKNOWN 结果不会产生用于诊断的反例。

paragraphs.en: This 586-program set is the fragment Ironproof proved, so its 100% column is true by construction and characterizes the LLM, not Ironproof —whose own rate on independent code is 52.6% today (§ 5.3 ). The LLM’s failures concentrate sharply by provenance: of the 94 independently authored programs in this baseline subset (GnuCOBOL, NIST, dscobol) it proves only 40 (42.6%), commits 30 Z3-confirmed semantic errors, and leaves 24 unverifiable, whereas on the 490 programs we generated or wrote it proves 480 (98.0%). The unverifiable class is a limitation of the shared encoder, not a difference between the generators—the LLM’s 24 independent unverifiable cases are the same kind of gap as Ironproof ’s own independent pipeline failures—so the encoder-neutral comparison looks only at Z3-decided outcomes. There the LLM was refuted on 30 of 94 (32%) in April. For the rule-based generator we have no measurement from April on the same population. On 2026-08-26 it was refuted on 6 programs (Table 4 ), and on the current code on none of its 291 independent checking-path programs (153 proved, 66 partially verified, 72 pipeline failures). The encoder changed between these dates, so we do not set either figure against the LLM’s 32%. The split is re-derivable with papers/baseline_split.py .
paragraphs.zh: 这个 586 程序集是 Ironproof 所证明的片段，因此其 100% 的列数据根据构造和特性为真，并用于表征 LLM，而非 Ironproof——Ironproof 自身在独立代码上的当前正确率仅为 52.6%（§ 5.3）。 LLM 的失败情况按来源高度集中：在这个基准子集（GnuCOBOL、NIST、dscobol）中，有 94 个由不同作者独立编写的程序，它仅能证明其中 40 个（42.6%），发现 30 个经 Z3 确认的语义错误，另有 24 个无法验证；而对我们生成或编写的 490 个程序，它能证明其中的 480 个（98.0%）。 无法验证的类别是共享编码器的局限性，而非生成器之间的差异——LLM 的 24 个独立无法验证的案例与 Ironproof 自身独立流程中的失败属于同一种缺失类型——因此，编码器中立的比较仅关注经 Z3 判定的结果。 在 4 月份，LLM 在 94 个案例中有 30 个（32%）被证伪。 对于基于规则的生成器，我们没有针对同一程序集在 4 月份的测量数据。 截至 2026-08-26，它在 6 个程序上被证伪（表 4），而在当前代码中，其 291 个独立检查路径程序中没有任何一个被证伪（153 个被证明，66 个部分验证，72 个流程失败）。 这两个日期之间的编码器发生了变化，因此我们不对这两个数值与 LLM 的 32% 进行比较。 该划分可通过 papers/baseline_split.py 重新推导得出。

sents.en: The unverifiable class is a limitation of the shared encoder, not a difference between the generators—the LLM’s 24 independent unverifiable cases are the same kind of gap as Ironproof ’s own independent pipeline failures—so the encoder-neutral comparison looks only at Z3-decided outcomes.

paragraphs.en: The LLM failure rate varies sharply across benchmark sources, ranging from 0% on synthetic inputs to 80% on enterprise code. On the 440 generated programs (pure arithmetic and conditionals), the LLM achieves 100% correctness—unsurprising, since these programs exercise narrow, predictable patterns. On independently authored code, failures dominate: 27 of 53 GnuCOBOL compiler tests fail (51% failure rate), 7 of 16 NIST CCVS85 programs fail (44%), and 20 of 25 dscobol enterprise programs fail (80%). Aggregated across the GnuCOBOL, NIST, and dscobol sources—94 programs, the subset of independently authored code used for this baseline—the LLM fails on 54 programs (57%) —30 Z3-confirmed semantic errors and 24 unverifiable translations, not 54 confirmed errors. (The few community programs, also independently authored, are counted with the hand-written set for this comparison rather than in the 94.) The remaining 12 failures occur on the 50 hand-written and 2 community programs (23% combined failure rate). On this baseline, LLM translation failed far more often on independently authored COBOL than on the programs we generated.

paragraphs.en: Z3 counterexamples on the 38 failed LLM translations reveal semantic errors across three categories:
paragraphs.zh: 对 38 个失败的 LLM 翻译中 Z3 反例的分析揭示了三大类语义错误：

paragraphs.en: Initialization and counting errors (21 programs): The LLM produces incorrect initial values or off-by-one counter updates, causing divergences on the first or last loop iteration. These errors are characteristic of programs with file I/O record counting and paragraph-level control flow.
paragraphs.zh: 初始化与计数错误（21 个程序）：大型语言模型会生成错误的初始值或出现“差一”的计数器更新，导致在第一次或最后一次循环迭代中出现偏差。 这类错误是包含文件 I/O 记录计数和段落级控制流程序的典型特征。

paragraphs.en: Conditional logic errors (10 programs): The LLM misinterprets compound conditions ( AND / OR combinations), nested EVALUATE branches, or NOT conditions, producing incorrect branch selection for specific input ranges.
paragraphs.zh: 条件逻辑错误（10 个程序）：LLM 错误地解释了复合条件（AND/OR 组合）、嵌套的 EVALUATE 分支或 NOT 条件，导致对特定输入范围做出错误的分支选择。

paragraphs.en: Arithmetic and type errors (7 programs): The LLM introduces computation errors including decimal precision loss, incorrect operator precedence in chained arithmetic, and missing GIVING clause handling.
paragraphs.zh: 算术和类型错误（7 个程序）：LLM 引入了计算错误，包括小数精度丢失、链式算术中操作符优先级不正确，以及缺少 GIVING 子句的处理。

paragraphs.en: On the independently authored COBOL in our baseline, LLM-only translation failed on 57% of programs. The rule-based code generator is not defect-free either: in the 2026-08-26 snapshot Z3 refuted 6 of its translations (§ 5.4 ). What the verification layer provides is not a generator that cannot err, but a machine-checkable filter that separates the translations we can stand behind from those we cannot. For programs outside the Z3-encodable fragment, Ironproof makes no equivalence claim.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们基准测试中独立编写的 COBOL 程序中，仅使用 LLM 的翻译方法在 57% 的程序上失败了。 基于规则的代码生成器也并非完美无瑕：在 2026-08-26 的快照中，Z3 驳回了其 6 个翻译结果（§ 5.4）。 验证层所提供的并非一个不会出错的生成器，而是一个机器可检查的过滤器，它将我们能够信赖的翻译与无法信赖的翻译区分开来。 对于超出 Z3 可编码片段范围的程序，Ironproof 并未声称其具有等价性。

paragraphs.en: The full benchmark spans 2,345 programs (median: 18 non-empty lines, mean: 68, range: 4–7,693). The proved fragment (606 programs) has median 17 lines, mean 130, max 7,693 lines. More important than size is the input domain: 37 proofs cover a single execution of a program that reads input the encoder does not model, and only 14 quantify over an input that a proved output depends on (§ 5.3 ). The provable fragment is concentrated in pure-computation programs; larger programs use I/O, loops, and string operations outside Z3 scope. Our evaluation measures Ironproof ’s capability on this pure-computation fragment, not on full-system migration. Production COBOL programs commonly span thousands of lines with complex inter-paragraph control flow.
paragraphs.zh: 整个基准测试涵盖 2,345 个程序（中位数：18 行非空代码，平均值：68，范围：4–7,693）。 可证明的片段（606 个程序）的中位数为 17 行，平均值为 130，最大值为 7,693 行。 比规模更重要的是输入域：37 个证明仅覆盖程序的单次执行，而该程序读取了编码器未建模的输入；仅有 14 个证明涉及可证明输出所依赖的输入（§ 5.3）。 可证明的片段主要集中在纯计算程序中；较大的程序使用了 I/O、循环和字符串操作，这些超出了 Z3 的作用范围。 我们的评估旨在衡量 Ironproof 在这一纯计算片段上的能力，而非整个系统的迁移能力。 生产环境中的 COBOL 程序通常包含数千行代码，并带有复杂的跨段落控制流。

paragraphs.en: The Z3 encoding uses Real arithmetic (infinite-precision rationals) to model both COBOL fixed-point and Python Decimal values. This is an over-approximation , not a sound encoding of COBOL semantics: Z3 Real does not model the finite range constraints of COBOL PIC clauses (e.g., PIC 9(2) can only represent values 0–99; incrementing 99 causes overflow or truncation depending on the compiler), nor does it model the ROUNDED clause or truncation behavior. Consequently, the encoding may miss divergences caused by overflow, truncation, or rounding—an equivalence proof does not cover divergences caused by overflow, by truncation on store (which occurs within range, for fractional digits), or by rounding. A more precise encoding using Z3 BitVec or bounded integer constraints with explicit range checks would be required to model these behaviors faithfully. We consider this a significant limitation that future work must address.
paragraphs.zh: Z3 编码使用实数运算（无限精度有理数）来模拟 COBOL 定点数和 Python Decimal 值。 这是一种过度近似，而非对 COBOL 语义的精确编码：Z3 实数无法模拟 COBOL PIC 子句的有限范围约束（例如，PIC 9(2) 只能表示 0–99 的值；将 99 递增会导致溢出或截断，具体取决于编译器），也无法模拟 ROUNDED 子句或截断行为。 因此，这种编码可能会遗漏由溢出、截断或四舍五入引起的发散——等价性证明并不涵盖由溢出、存储时的截断（在范围内发生，适用于小数位）或四舍五入引起的发散。 要忠实地模拟这些行为，需要使用 Z3 BitVec 或有明确范围检查的有界整数约束来实现更精确的编码。 我们认为这是一个重要的局限性，未来的工作必须解决这一问题。

paragraphs.en: Our benchmark draws from the NIST CCVS85 validation suite and the GnuCOBOL compiler test suite—both independently authored and publicly available. However, these are test programs , not production codebases. To measure the distance, we ran the same encoder on two public business-application corpora pinned at fixed commits: AWS CardDemo (44 programs, median 509 lines, Apache-2.0, commit 59cc6c2 ) and IBM GenApp (31 programs, EPL-2.0, commit f6f3f4b ). No program of either is modeled end to end. At paragraph scale, 1 of CardDemo’s 573 paragraphs is modeled, a single statement, and none of GenApp’s 139. The dominant obstacles are CICS identifiers ( EIBCALEN , EIBTRNID ), embedded SQL and SQLCODE , alphanumeric targets, and GO TO ; 46 CardDemo and 5 GenApp copybooks were not found, which can only lower these counts further. Evaluation on proprietary production code from specific industries would strengthen external validity, but on public business code the current encoder’s reach is close to zero.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的基准测试参考了 NIST CCVS85 验证套件和 GnuCOBOL 编译器测试套件——两者均由独立作者编写且可供公开获取。 然而，这些是测试程序，而非生产代码库。 为了衡量距离差异，我们对两个固定提交版本下的公开业务应用语料库运行了相同的编码器：AWS CardDemo（44 个程序，中位数 509 行，Apache-2.0 许可，提交版本 59cc6c2）和 IBM GenApp（31 个程序，EPL-2.0 许可，提交版本 f6f3f4b）。 这两个语料库中没有任何一个程序被端到端地建模。 在段落层面，CardDemo 的 573 个段落中有 1 个被建模（仅一个语句），而 GenApp 的 139 个段落中则没有一个被建模。 主要障碍包括 CICS 标识符（EIBCALEN、EIBTRNID）、嵌入式 SQL 和 SQLCODE、字母数字目标以及 GO TO；此外，CardDemo 中有 46 个和 GenApp 中有 5 个复制书未被找到，这只会使上述数量进一步减少。 在特定行业的专有生产代码上进行评估将增强外部效度，但在公开业务代码上，当前编码器的覆盖范围几乎为零。

paragraphs.en: We measure “semantic accuracy” as Z3 equivalence on the pure computational fragment. This is a precise but narrow metric: it does not cover I/O behavior, SQL semantics, or loop termination. Programs with no encodable output are outside the checking path; programs that enter it are counted even when they contain constructs the encoder does not model (§ 5.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将“语义准确性”衡量为纯计算片段上的 Z3 等价性。 这是一个精确但狭隘的指标：它不涵盖 I/O 行为、SQL 语义或循环终止。 没有可编码输出的程序不在检查路径之外；进入该路径的程序即使包含编码器未建模的结构也会被计入（§ 5.4）。

paragraphs.en: Ironproof ’s formal verification is limited to pure computational sections —arithmetic, conditionals, and multi-way branches without loops, I/O, or external calls. This is a fundamental limitation of the encoding approach: representing loops symbolically requires loop invariant synthesis, which is itself an undecidable problem in general. We discuss directions for relaxing this limitation below.
paragraphs.zh: Ironproof 的形式化验证仅限于纯粹的计算部分——即不包含循环、I/O 或外部调用的算术运算、条件判断和多路分支。 这是编码方法的一个根本性限制：以符号方式表示循环需要合成循环不变量，而这个问题本身在一般情况下是不可判定的。 我们将在下文讨论放宽这一限制的可能方向。

paragraphs.en: The COBOL parser covers 10 construct types but does not handle the full COBOL-85 standard (which has approximately 250 reserved words). Notable unsupported constructs include INSPECT , STRING / UNSTRING , SORT , ALTER , REDEFINES , OCCURS (table handling), COMP-3 (packed decimal), level-88 condition names, and nested programs. Several of these—particularly level-88 conditions, REDEFINES , and OCCURS —are ubiquitous in production COBOL. The current 10-construct scope covers a narrow slice of the language; extending the parser to handle these constructs is essential for practical applicability.
paragraphs.zh: 该 COBOL 解析器涵盖了 10 种结构类型，但并未支持完整的 COBOL-85 标准（该标准约有 250 个保留词）。 目前不支持的重要结构包括 INSPECT、STRING/UNSTRING、SORT、ALTER、REDEFINES、OCCURS（表处理）、COMP-3（打包十进制）、level-88 条件名以及嵌套程序。 其中一些结构——尤其是 level-88 条件、REDEFINES 和 OCCURS——在生产环境中的 COBOL 代码中极为常见。 当前仅涵盖 10 种结构的范围只涉及该语言的一小部分；为了使其具备实际应用能力，必须扩展解析器以支持这些结构。

paragraphs.en: RQ5 compares Ironproof ’s rule-based transpilation against LLM-only translation on the Z3-provable fragment, quantifying the value of the formal verification layer. However, we do not compare against commercial COBOL modernization tools (e.g., IBM watsonx Code Assistant for Z, AWS Mainframe Modernization), which would require access to proprietary tooling and production COBOL codebases. A comparison against these offerings on shared benchmarks remains necessary to fully establish Ironproof ’s practical positioning.

paragraphs.en: The 2,345-program benchmark includes real, independently authored code from the GnuCOBOL compiler test suite and the NIST CCVS85 validation suite. However, 66.7% of these programs yield no Z3-encodable output at all, a further 3.2% fail inside our own pipeline, and only 14 of the 606 proofs quantify over an input that a proved output depends on. Production COBOL programs commonly span thousands of lines with complex inter-paragraph control flow, nested COPY books, and COMP-3 packed decimal. Extending the Z3-encodable fragment to cover loops, I/O effects, and string operations would substantially increase the provable proportion.
paragraphs.zh: 2,345 程序基准测试包含了来自 GnuCOBOL 编译器测试套件和 NIST CCVS85 验证套件的真实、独立编写的代码。 然而，其中 66.7% 的程序完全无法生成可 Z3 编码的输出，另有 3.2% 的程序在我们的处理流程中失败，而 606 个证明中仅有 14 个对输入进行了量化，这些输入是已证明输出所依赖的。 生产环境中的 COBOL 程序通常包含数千行代码，具有复杂的跨段落控制流、嵌套的 COPY 书以及 COMP-3 打包十进制格式。 将可 Z3 编码的片段扩展以涵盖循环、I/O 效应和字符串操作，将显著增加可证明的比例。

paragraphs.en: The confrontation of § 5.5 ran once, on an earlier pipeline, with a harness that was not versioned. Re-running it on the current pipeline, from a script in the artifact, comes before any other extension: it is the only measurement in this paper that checks the IR against a COBOL implementation.

paragraphs.en: The current Z3 encoding uses Real (infinite-precision rationals), which over-approximates COBOL’s fixed-point semantics. Replacing this with Z3 BitVec constraints or bounded integers with explicit PIC-derived range constraints would enable detection of overflow and truncation bugs that the current encoding misses. This is the most critical improvement for the soundness of Ironproof ’s formal guarantees.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的 Z3 编码使用 Real（无限精度有理数），这会对 COBOL 的定点语义进行过度近似。 用 Z3 BitVec 约束或具有显式 PIC 派生范围约束的有界整数来替代这一做法，将能够检测出当前编码所遗漏的溢出和截断错误。 这对 Ironproof 形式化保证的正确性而言是最关键的改进。

paragraphs.en: For PERFORM UNTIL and PERFORM VARYING loops, an invariant-based approach could extend Z3 verification to iterative constructs. Given a loop PERFORM UNTIL cond , a candidate invariant I I would need to satisfy: (1) I I holds before the loop; (2) if I ∧ ¬ cond I\wedge\neg\text{cond} holds, then I I holds after one iteration; and (3) I ∧ cond I\wedge\text{cond} implies the desired postcondition. LLMs could be used to propose candidate invariants, with Z3 checking the three conditions, creating a nested LLM-Z3 loop.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 PERFORM UNTIL 和 PERFORM VARYING 循环，一种基于不变量的方法可以将 Z3 验证扩展到迭代结构。 给定一个 PERFORM UNTIL cond 循环，候选不变量 I 需要满足以下条件：(1) I 在循环开始前成立；(2) 如果 I ∧ ¬ cond 成立，则 I 在一次迭代后仍然成立；以及 (3) I ∧ cond 能够推导出期望的后续条件。 可以使用 LLM 提出候选不变量，并由 Z3 验证这三个条件，从而形成一个嵌套的 LLM-Z3 循环。

paragraphs.en: File I/O and SQL constructs could be approximated using abstract interpretation: rather than modeling the concrete file system or database, we could model the effect of I/O operations on working storage variables using an over-approximate abstract domain, enabling partial verification of programs that mix computation with I/O.
paragraphs.zh: 文件 I/O 和 SQL 结构可以通过抽象解释进行近似：与其对具体的文件系统或数据库进行建模，不如使用一个过度近似的抽象域来建模 I/O 操作对工作存储变量的影响，从而能够部分验证将计算与 I/O 相结合的程序。

paragraphs.en: Compositional verification—proving equivalence paragraph-by-paragraph and then composing the proofs—would allow Ironproof to handle larger programs. This requires modeling the calling conventions between paragraphs and ensuring that composed proofs remain sound.
paragraphs.zh: 组合验证——即逐段证明等价性，然后将这些证明组合起来——将使得 Ironproof 能够处理更大型的程序。 这需要对各段落之间的调用约定进行建模，并确保组合后的证明仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: COBOL modernization has been studied for decades ( Sneed, 2010 ) . Traditional approaches rely on rule-based source-to-source transformation. IBM watsonx Code Assistant for Z ( IBM, 2026 ) assists COBOL-to-Java transformation with an LLM, and AWS Mainframe Modernization ( Amazon Web Services, 2026 ) offers tools to refactor mainframe applications. Pan et al. ( Pan et al., 2024 ) study bugs introduced by LLMs when translating between C, C++, Go, Java and Python; COBOL is not among the languages they study. Ironproof focuses on machine-checkable equivalence proofs for the computational core of translated programs; we have not evaluated whether these products provide comparable checks.
paragraphs.zh: COBOL 的现代化问题已被研究数十年（Sneed，2010）。 传统方法依赖于基于规则的源到源转换。 IBM watsonx Code Assistant for Z（IBM，2026）借助大型语言模型辅助 COBOL 到 Java 的转换，而 AWS Mainframe Modernization（Amazon Web Services，2026）则提供了重构大型机应用程序的工具。Pan 等人 （Pan 等人，2024）研究了大型语言模型在 C、C++、Go、Java 和 Python 之间进行翻译时引入的缺陷；COBOL 并未包含在他们研究的语言中。 Ironproof 专注于为转换后程序的计算核心提供机器可验证的等价性证明；我们尚未评估这些产品是否提供了同等水平的检查。

paragraphs.en: TransCoder ( Rozière et al., 2020 ) demonstrated unsupervised programming language translation using back-translation on monolingual corpora. Chen et al. ( Chen et al., 2021 ) evaluate Codex, a model pretrained on code, on generating Python from natural-language descriptions. StarCoder ( Li et al., 2023 ) and other open models have further advanced the state of the art. Gao et al. ( Gao et al., 2023 ) study what makes effective in-context demonstrations for code intelligence tasks. Jain et al. ( Jain et al., 2022 ) combine LLMs with program synthesis for code generation. paragraphs.en: Translation validation—verifying that a compiler or translator preserves semantics—originates with Pnueli et al. Ironproof addresses a different problem—cross-language translation validation between COBOL and Python—which requires bridging a much larger semantic gap.

paragraphs.en: We have presented Ironproof , a pipeline for COBOL-to-Python transpilation that combines rule-based Python emission with Z3-based formal equivalence verification and an LLM-driven feedback loop for error correction. Ironproof parses COBOL programs into a typed intermediate representation covering 10 constructs, generates Python with Decimal -typed arithmetic, encodes both programs as Z3 formulas over shared symbolic variables, and checks whether any input witnesses a semantic divergence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Ironproof，这是一条用于 COBOL 到 Python 跨编译的流程，它将基于规则的 Python 代码生成与基于 Z3 的形式化等价性验证相结合，并引入由 LLM 驱动的反馈循环进行错误修正。 Ironproof 将 COBOL 程序解析为覆盖 10 种构造的带类型中间表示，使用 Decimal 类型算术生成 Python 代码，将两个程序编码为基于共享符号变量的 Z3 公式，并检查是否存在任何输入能够证明语义差异。

paragraphs.en: On a benchmark of 2,345 COBOL programs—including 1,632 from the GnuCOBOL compiler test suite and 69 from the NIST CCVS85 validation suite— Ironproof proves equivalence on 606 of the 782 programs that enter the checking path (77.5%) , and on 153 of 291 (52.6%) when the code is independently authored. Our own pipeline’s 75 failures stay in the denominator. Two limits govern how far those proofs reach. 37 of the independent proofs cover a single execution of a program that reads input the encoder does not model, and only 14 proofs quantify over an input that a proved output depends on. And on two public business-application corpora, the encoder models no program end to end. The benchmark itself no longer refutes any translation of our generator, because the later hardening stops earlier the six programs it refuted on 2026-08-26; the obligation’s capacity to fail is shown by those six and by 38 LLM translations. A baseline run in April 2026 shows that, on 94 independently authored programs, LLM-only translation failed on 57%—Z3-confirmed semantic divergences together with translations our encoder could not verify. PIC-bounded overflow detection flags at least one out-of-range output in 22.1% of the programs it can analyze—an upper bound, since the analysis quantifies over unconstrained inputs. Confronting the proved programs of the 2026-08-26 pipeline with GnuCOBOL 3.2.0 (§ 5.5 ), 24 of the 49 we could execute end to end disagreed with the reference runtime on a variable inside the proof’s own domain. An emission-fidelity proof is therefore a filter, not a substitute for confrontation with an implementation.

paragraphs.en: Ironproof does not claim to solve the full COBOL modernization problem. Its formal verification is limited to pure computational sections, its parser covers a narrow subset of COBOL-85, and comparison against commercial modernization tools remains necessary. paragraphs.en: The initial translation prompt instructs the LLM to translate COBOL to Python while preserving exact semantics.
